title: Graceful client detach, partial-output compaction, and function-call-aware backpressure
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Problem: Client disconnects during streaming generations cause resource waste (GPU/ephemeral KV state), inconsistent structured outputs when function/tool calls are in-flight, and hard-to-reproduce partial outputs seen by downstream consumers. Older SDKs do not support resume tokens or structured-function-call checkpoints, forcing servers to either keep long-lived state or drop progress.

Goals:
- Provide a deterministic, low-cost server-side protocol to detect and finalize partial generations when clients disconnect or time out.
- Ensure tool/function calls and structured outputs are either completed or deterministically aborted with clear markers in the final event stream.
- Introduce a compacted partial-output artifact (checkpoint) that safely contains minimal KV/prefix and function-call state to allow resumption or safe GC.
- Maintain compatibility with pre-resume clients by falling back to a finalization protocol and offering an explicit non-resume event.

Constraints: runtime cannot pin GPU memory > 30s for orphaned sessions at scale; structured outputs must not be half-committed to tool endpoints; compatibility shim required for older language SDKs.
acceptance_criteria: When a client disconnects ungracefully, server emits a PartialFinalized event within 10s and releases associated ephemeral KV/prefix state within 30s unless a resume token exists.
Function/tool call sequences in partially finalized streams are either completed atomically or aborted with a FunctionAbort marker that includes safe rollback hints.
Resume token artifact size is bounded (<16KB) and contains compacted prefix hashes + minimal KV checkpoint to allow resumption on compatible clients.
Backpressure policy will treat in-flight function calls as high-priority slices; the adaptive lease mechanism reduces batching window to preserve tail latency for these slices.
Legacy clients receive a clear NonResumeFinalized event and can safely retry without risking duplicated external tool calls.
E2E tests covering abrupt TCP disconnects, TLS client shutdown, and SDK process kill reproduce cleanup behavior and pass on CI with <5% flakiness.
design_decisions: Use a two-phase finalizer: (1) emit PartialFinalized with resumeToken; (2) after grace window, GC resources. This reduces pinned state without surprising clients.
Checkpoint format: compressed JSON with deterministic ordering + zstd; include prefix hashes and a minimal function-call breadcrumb (no full args payload unless safe-to-store flag set by user).

Function calls: treat external calls as transactions; record 3-way handshake with tool adapter. If handshake incomplete at detach, emit FunctionAbort with rollback hint. Avoid retries by default to prevent duplicate effects.
Compatibility: older SDKs get NonResumeFinalized (no token) and a telemetry event suggesting client upgrade; SDKs supporting resume will automatically exchange tokens during reconnect.
implementation_notes: Server: add Finalizer worker that watches stream leases and produces PartialFinalized/NonResumeFinalized events (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8123).
Runtime: implement checkpoint encoder/decoder (zstd + deterministic JSON) and store compressed artifact in ephemeral object store with 1h TTL by default.
Adapters: update tool adapters to accept abort and rollback hints; new adapter API: /v1/adapter/abort with idempotency-key support (spec draft linked in GH PR).
SDK: expose resumeToken plumbing and NonResumeFinalized handler; add integration test harness that simulates process-kill reconnect sequences.

Telemetry: emit debug-level event when PartialFinalized produced and record resource reclamation latency in console-telemetry dashboard (dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/stream-finalizer).
comments: 2026-03-02 Tomas: Spike complete. Proof-of-concept finalizer emits PartialFinalized and GC loop reclaims KV in ~22s. Observed worst-case checkpoint size 9.2KB for typical chat session.
2026-03-03 Design review (Lena): Concern about UX for tool-call aborts. Recommend adding explicit client-facing field 'tool_call_status' in PartialFinalized.
2026-03-04 Aisha: Updated checkpoint to include tool_call_status summary (success|inflight|aborted) and stripped arg payloads when 'store_args' false. Pushed change to PR 8123.
2026-03-06 QA (Rajat): Added flaky test that simulates 1% network packet loss; observed a race where resume attempt hits a reclaimed checkpoint if reconnect <10s. Raised as follow-up (ENG-762001).
2026-03-09 Tomas: Implemented grace-window extension hook for admin override. Console exposes per-customer default (30s) and overrides for high-value customers. PR 8180 open for review.
2026-03-10 PM (Nora): Prioritize making NonResumeFinalized human-readable in SDKs; users reported confusion in early dogfood. Moved to P1 for SDK docs update.
notes: Rollout plan: gated Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with runtime flag 'enable_finalizer_v2'. Monitor GC latency and function-call abort rates.
We need legal review if we ever store full function call arguments in checkpoints for EU tenants; add data-retention policy toggle per-tenant.
